_about: Kavach legal corpus. Summaries are plain-language paraphrases written for retrieval and drafting, NOT the statutory text. Section numbers and punishments were checked against secondary sources (devgan.in, vidhijudicial.com, SFLC) on 2026-10-16. Before the demo, confirm every entry against the official text on indiacode.nic.in and set verified=true.

sections.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
sections.summary: Using assault or criminal force on a woman intending to outrage her modesty, or knowing it is likely to do so.
sections.punishment: Imprisonment of 1 to 5 years and fine.
sections.online_applicability: low: needs physical assault or force, so rarely fits a purely online chat

sections.title: Sexual harassment
sections.summary: A man committing sexual harassment: unwelcome physical contact and advances, a demand or request for sexual favours, showing pornography against a woman's will, or making sexually coloured remarks.
sections.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine, or both for contact, demands or showing pornography; up to 1 year, or fine, or both for sexually coloured remarks.
sections.online_applicability: high: sexual remarks and demands for pictures over chat

sections.title: Voyeurism
sections.summary: Watching or capturing the image of a woman engaged in a private act where she would expect not to be observed, or disseminating such an image. Sharing an image with others is an offence even if she consented to the image being taken but not to it being shared.
sections.punishment: First conviction 1 to 3 years and fine; subsequent conviction 3 to 7 years and fine.
sections.online_applicability: high when intimate images were captured or shared; for threats to share, pair with extortion or intimidation

sections.title: Stalking
sections.summary: A man who follows or contacts a woman, or tries to contact her to foster personal interaction repeatedly despite her clear disinterest, or who monitors her use of the internet, email or any other electronic communication.
sections.punishment: First conviction up to 3 years and fine; subsequent conviction up to 5 years and fine.
sections.online_applicability: high: repeated online contact after she said no, new accounts after blocking, monitoring her online activity

sections.title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
sections.summary: Saying any word, making any sound or gesture, or exhibiting any object, intending that a woman hear or see it and that it insult her modesty, or intruding upon her privacy.
sections.punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.
sections.online_applicability: high: sexual slurs and vulgar messages sent to her

sections.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by use of acid, and attempting to throw acid
sections.summary: Causing permanent or partial damage, deformity or burns by throwing or administering acid (124(1)), or throwing or attempting to throw acid with that intention (124(2)).
sections.punishment: 124(1): at least 10 years, up to life, and fine; 124(2): 5 to 7 years and fine.
sections.online_applicability: low: needs an actual attack or attempt; a threat to throw acid is criminal intimidation (BNS 351(3)), not this section

sections.title: Extortion
sections.summary: Intentionally putting a person in fear of injury (including injury to reputation) and so dishonestly inducing them to deliver property or money. Putting someone in fear in order to commit extortion is itself punishable (308(3)).
sections.punishment: 308(2): up to 7 years, or fine, or both; 308(3) attempt by putting in fear: up to 2 years; higher where the fear is of death or grievous hurt (308(5)).
sections.online_applicability: high: demanding money under threat of leaking images or other harm

sections.title: Cheating
sections.summary: Deceiving a person and dishonestly inducing them to deliver property or do something they would not otherwise do, causing harm. Cheating that induces delivery of property is punishable more heavily (318(4)).
sections.punishment: 318(2): up to 3 years, or fine, or both; 318(4): up to 7 years and fine.
sections.online_applicability: high for online fraud that tricks her into paying or sharing banking details

sections.title: Cheating by personation
sections.summary: Cheating by pretending to be some other person, real or imaginary, or by knowingly substituting one person for another.
sections.punishment: 319(2): up to 5 years, or fine, or both.
sections.online_applicability: high when someone poses as her or as an official to cheat others

sections.title: Forgery (including forgery for harming reputation)
sections.summary: Making a false document or false electronic record with intent to cause damage or injury, or to commit fraud. 336(4) covers forgery intended to harm a person's reputation.
sections.punishment: 336(2): up to 2 years, or fine, or both; 336(4) for harming reputation: up to 3 years and fine.
sections.online_applicability: medium: morphed images or fake electronic records made to damage her reputation

sections.title: Criminal intimidation
sections.summary: Threatening a person with injury to their body, reputation or property, or to someone they care about, to cause alarm or to make them do or stop doing something. 351(3) is the aggravated form: threats of death or grievous hurt, or to impute unchastity to a woman. 351(4) adds punishment when the threat is anonymous or the sender hides their identity.
sections.punishment: 351(2): up to 2 years, or fine, or both; 351(3): up to 7 years, or fine, or both; 351(4): up to 2 years in addition.
sections.online_applicability: high: threats of harm or to expose her made over chat, including from fake or anonymous accounts

sections.title: Defamation
sections.summary: Making or publishing an imputation about a person, by words, signs or visible representations, intending to harm their reputation or knowing it is likely to.
sections.punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both, or community service.
sections.online_applicability: medium: when false or damaging claims about her were actually published to others

sections.title: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace
sections.summary: Intentionally insulting a person, intending or knowing it is likely to provoke them to break the public peace or commit another offence.
sections.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both.
sections.online_applicability: low: usually weaker than BNS 79 for sexualised abuse of a woman

sections.title: Computer related offences
sections.summary: Dishonestly or fraudulently doing any act referred to in section 43, such as accessing a computer, account or device without permission, or downloading, damaging or deleting data.
sections.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine up to 5 lakh rupees, or both.
sections.online_applicability: medium: when her account or device was accessed without permission

sections.title: Punishment for identity theft
sections.summary: Fraudulently or dishonestly using another person's electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature.
sections.punishment: Up to 3 years and fine up to 1 lakh rupees.
sections.online_applicability: high: a fake profile using her photos, name or login

sections.title: Punishment for cheating by personation by using computer resource
sections.summary: Cheating by personation using any communication device or computer resource.
sections.punishment: Up to 3 years and fine up to 1 lakh rupees.
sections.online_applicability: high: online impersonation used to cheat her or others

sections.title: Punishment for violation of privacy
sections.summary: Intentionally or knowingly capturing, publishing or transmitting the image of a private area of any person without consent, in circumstances violating their privacy.
sections.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine up to 2 lakh rupees, or both.
sections.online_applicability: high when intimate images were captured, published or sent without consent

sections.title: Punishment for publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form
sections.summary: Publishing or transmitting, or causing to be published or transmitted, in electronic form any material that is lascivious or appeals to the prurient interest.
sections.punishment: First conviction up to 3 years and fine up to 5 lakh rupees; subsequent conviction up to 5 years and fine up to 10 lakh rupees.
sections.online_applicability: medium: obscene content sent to her or posted online

sections.title: Punishment for publishing or transmitting material containing sexually explicit act in electronic form
sections.summary: Publishing or transmitting in electronic form any material containing a sexually explicit act or conduct.
sections.punishment: First conviction up to 5 years and fine up to 10 lakh rupees; subsequent conviction up to 7 years and fine up to 10 lakh rupees.
sections.online_applicability: high only when sexually explicit material was actually published or sent
